meta.parties: Cassim v. De Vos Et Al

rules.statement: The Partition Ordinance reserves the right of a party to claim damages if they act bona fide and in ignorance of the rights of third parties, or if their action causes damage even without fraudulent intent.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is unnecessary to consider whether the act of the first defendant was fraudulent or wilful. It is sufficient that he caused the damage, and that it was done knowing that the present plaintiff had preferred a claim to the land."
